final: SELECT p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_aCL_IgG, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ANA, AVG(e.ANA) / (SELECT AVG(sex_avg_ana) FROM (SELECT AVG(e2.ANA) AS sex_avg_ana FROM Examination e2 JOIN Patient p2 ON e2.ID = p2.ID GROUP BY p2.SEX)) AS ANA_normalized FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX
